init.title: NWP500 Options
init.description: Configure advanced settings for your Navien NWP500 integration.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll device status (10-300 seconds). Lower values provide faster updates but may increase server load. Default: 30 seconds.
data_description.control_enabled: Optional, and off unless you turn it on. Lets a scheduler of your own, such as an automation or a Node-RED flow, set this water heater's temperature and mode over time. Leave it off if you don't have one.

external_control.title: External control
external_control.description: External control needs a scheduler of your own, such as an automation, a Node-RED flow or a script, and does nothing without one. Your scheduler publishes a plan: a list of times, each with the temperature and mode to use from then on. External control writes the plan into the heater's own schedule, so the heater keeps following it even while Home Assistant is down. How to publish a plan: {guide_url}

data_description.control_intent_entity: The entity your scheduler puts its plan on, such as an MQTT sensor. Its state is the plan's ID and its attributes are the plan.
data_description.control_mode: Preview works out what the plan would do and shows it, without changing the heater. Live writes the plan into the heater's schedule, as your scheduler sends it. Stopped stops applying plans: nothing more is written, and what is on the heater stays there. To remove external control completely, turn it off on the first page.
data_description.control_reservation_entry_limit: The most entries the heater's schedule may hold in total, your own included. External control uses what is left after your entries and the ones kept free. Navien documents 16; the heater tested held 32.
data_description.control_reservation_entry_reserve: Entries kept free for changes that must happen right away, such as a plan step that has already begun. Must be less than the schedule size limit.

error.reserve_exceeds_limit: “Schedule entries kept free” must be less than the schedule size limit.

set_reservation.name: Set reservation
set_reservation.description: Create or update a single reservation schedule entry. An existing entry scheduled for the same days and time is replaced, so repeating a call updates it rather than adding a duplicate. Reservations allow automatic mode and temperature changes at scheduled times. The device supports up to 16 reservation entries.

device_id.description: The target NWP500 water heater device

enabled.description: Whether this reservation entry is active

days.name: Days
days.description: Days of the week for this reservation. Select one or more days.

hour.name: Hour
hour.description: Hour of day (0-23) when reservation activates

minute.name: Minute
minute.description: Minute of hour (0-59) when reservation activates

mode.name: Operation mode
mode.description: DHW operation mode to set when reservation activates

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature, in Home Assistant's temperature unit and within the heater's range. Required for heating modes, ignored for Vacation and power off.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity ID of the water heater (alternative to Device ID)

update_reservations.name: Update all reservations
update_reservations.description: Replace all reservation entries with a new list. An advanced service for setting several entries at once; Set reservation adds a single entry.

entity_id.name: Entity

set_vacation_duration.description: Change the vacation day count without changing the operation mode. Unlike set_vacation_days, this does not put the device into vacation mode; it only updates the number of days (1-30) the next vacation period will last.

configure_tou_schedule.name: Configure TOU schedule
configure_tou_schedule.description: Configure the Time of Use (TOU) pricing schedule on the device. Up to 16 periods can be defined with seasonal, weekly, and time-based pricing information. The device uses this to optimize heating based on electricity rates.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The target NWP500 water heater device

periods.description: List of TOU period entries (max 16). Each entry is a dictionary with keys: season (month bitfield 0-4095), week (day bitfield 0-254, Sun=128..Sat=2), start_hour (0-23), start_minute (0-59), end_hour (0-23), end_minute (0-59), price_min (encoded price), price_max (encoded price), decimal_point (decimal places for price).

request_tou_settings.name: Request TOU settings
request_tou_settings.description: Read the programmed Time of Use (TOU) plan from the Navien cloud. The device has no way to report its TOU plan directly, so this reads the stored plan over the REST API. It updates the TOU schedule sensor and fires an nwp500_tou_updated event.

get_energy_usage.name: Get energy usage
get_energy_usage.description: Ask the water heater for its recorded energy usage and return it as a report. The device keeps daily totals split between the heat pump and the electric heating elements; nothing is recorded in Home Assistant, the data is returned to the caller. Defaults to the current month. Ask for whole years instead to get one total per month.

months.description: Months to report on. Several may be requested at once. Defaults to the current month.

years.name: Years
years.description: Whole years to report on, one total per month. Cannot be combined with Year or Months.
